details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: [fanfare] Discard 3 cards: Put a Great Testimony token into your EX area. [act] Banish a Mjerrabaine, Omen of One from your cemetery: Deal 2 damage to each enemy leader. Draw 2 cards. Activate only once per turn.

issues: The fanfare cost is encoded incorrectly as optionalCost. '[fanfare] Discard 3 cards: Put a Great Testimony token into your EX area.' is a mandatory fanfare cost/effect line and should not be optional.

The activated cost is malformed. It should use the implemented activated cost shape with banishFromCemetery containing both filter and count, e.g. banishing 1 card named 'Mjerrabaine, Omen of One' from your cemetery.

The activated damage effect is encoded incorrectly: 'Deal 2 damage to each enemy leader' should hit enemy leaders only, not enemy followers. Replace dealDamageAllEnemies with an effect that deals 2 to enemy leaders only.

details.effect: [evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this follower. Rush. At the start of your end phase, if there are 2 cards or less in your hand, deal 3 damage to each enemy leader. If there are 0 cards in your hand, deal 3 damage to each enemy follower on the field.

issues: The end-phase damage effect is encoded incorrectly: if you have 2 or fewer cards in hand, it should deal 3 damage to each enemy leader only, not to enemy followers as well. Replace that branch with leader-only damage.

The 0-cards-in-hand clause is nested under else, so it will never apply when you have 0 cards in hand. It should be an additional effect checked independently after the leader-damage clause, since both clauses apply when hand size is 0.
Keywords are incorrect: 'evolve' should not be listed in keywords. The evolve line should be represented by evolveCost/evolvesTo only.

details.effect: At the start of your end phase, refresh this card and, if there are 2 cards or less in your hand, deal 5 damage to each enemy leader. If there are 0 cards in your hand, deal 5 damage to each enemy follower on the field.

issues: The end-phase damage effect is encoded incorrectly: if you have 2 or fewer cards in hand, it should deal 5 damage to each enemy leader only, not to enemy followers as well. Replace that branch with leader-only damage.

The 0-cards-in-hand clause is nested under else, so it will never apply when you have 0 cards in hand. It should be checked independently after refreshing and the leader-damage clause, since both clauses apply when hand size is 0.

details.effect: [evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this follower. [fanfare] [cost02], Lesson (1): Give this follower [attack]+1/[defense]+1. (To perform Lesson (1), banish a Magical Item token from your EX area.)

issues: Keywords are incorrect: 'evolve' and 'fanfare' should not be listed in keywords. The evolve line should be represented by evolveCost/evolvesTo, and Fanfare should remain only as the ability timing.
